response.text:
I can’t give an exact value from a chart that’s too blurry to read. If the axis labels, tick marks, or data labels aren’t legible, any “exact” number would be a guess — I won’t fabricate that.

I can help in one of these ways — which would you prefer?
- You upload the original (or a higher-resolution) image or the source data, and I’ll read the value exactly.
- I attempt an image-enhancement + visual estimate (sharpen/contrast/zoom) and give an approximate value with an uncertainty range and clear caveats.
- You tell me the chart’s data table or the numeric values behind it and I’ll report the tallest bar exactly.

Tell me which option you want, and if you want an estimate now say how precise you need (e.g., nearest whole number, nearest 5, or a percentage range).
